dataset: Hormozinezhad, Barnes, Fabregat, Cito, Del Giudice, Lab Chip 25:1681-1693 (2025), DOI 10.1039/D4LC00946K; ESI obtained as the Europe PMC supplementary bundle of PMC11834948
intake_basis: file list, sheet names, header rows, numeric-cell counts per column and per-sheet device constants only; no target value was read before this binding was written

workbooks.description: non-Newtonian continuous phase (HA), 190 um etching depth x 195 um width device; one sheet per continuous-phase surfactant condition
second continuous-phase HA level (identity of the two levels, 0.5 and 0.05 wt%, is not needed by the protocol and is not inferred here); same device and sheet names as s003
non-Newtonian dispersed phase (HA concentration per sheet, plus Water), 100 um etching depth x 105 um width device

excluded_members.LC-025-D4LC00946K-s001.xlsx: inverse-design prediction tables of the paper (actual vs predicted flow rates), not raw experiments
excluded_members.LC-025-D4LC00946K-s006.pdf, s007.pdf, s0: code listings and figure supplement; documentation only

columns.dimensionless_note: Alpha and Wi are taken from the workbook's own column (alpha_col, wi_col); Wi is the Weissenberg number of the non-Newtonian phase of that workbook (continuous for s003/s004, dispersed for s005) and is labelled Wi in the unified table

parsing_rules.header_row: first row whose cells contain header_marker
parsing_rules.experiment_row: a row below the header with numeric Qd and Qc
parsing_rules.constant_broadcast: an input column with exactly one numeric cell in a sheet is a per-sheet constant (device depth/width, the Newtonian phase viscosity, interfacial tension) and is broadcast to every experiment row of that sheet
parsing_rules.missing_target: rows without a numeric L are dropped from the analysis table and counted in the manifest
parsing_rules.missing_input: rows with any missing native or dimensionless input after broadcast are dropped and counted

groups.S0: row-random 80/20 inside the development set, seeds 0-14
groups.S1_note: only two device geometries exist; a geometry hold-out is the S3 tier
groups.S3: device = (Etching Depth, Width); two levels: 190x195 and 100x105

sealing_rules.S2: among fluid_family levels with >= 10 target rows, excluding every level that attains the maximum count, choose the level whose count is closest to the median of the eligible counts; ties -> lexicographically smallest level name
sealing_rules.S3: same rule on device levels; if the chosen S3 level's rows intersect the S2 sealed rows, take the next candidate; if none remains, S3 is not sealed and is evaluated only as development leave-one-device-out (retrospective, labels open)

hard_bound_note: droplet length L may exceed the channel width (plug regime), so no physical upper bound is defined; the bounded model is the log-target MLP, the unbounded model the raw-scale MLP (H-B B1 only)
anchor_note: the paper's dimensionless correlations are fitted scalings without a prefactor valid across all sheets; H-B B2 is not evaluable on this dataset

tolerance.absolute_rule: 0.10 x development-set median L_um (computed by the custodian from development labels and written to the devdiag file)

target_scale_rule: development labels only: log target if max/min > 10 or skewness > 2, else raw scale
